source_format.section_checksum: Adler-32 over section header plus encoded payload, verified
source_format.object_framing: 1-byte object type + little-endian uint32 payload length
source_format.note: mesh object counts below are M3G Mesh objects, not triangle counts

interpretation.exterior_lods: Files *_a.m3g through *_h.m3g contain embedded LOD_A through LOD_H object labels respectively; this is explicit source evidence of an eight-level exterior LOD ladder.
interpretation.interior: *_int_a.m3g and *_int_b.m3g contain dedicated interior geometry with LOD_A_INT_* labels.
interpretation.shared: *_shared.m3g contains shared high-detail components such as brake calipers, bonnet-camera pieces, emissive light glows and exhaust glow where present.
interpretation.far_lods: LOD_G and LOD_H collapse to one Mesh object in every audited vehicle, making the recovered source inherently useful for Android far-distance representation.
interpretation.damage: Embedded source labels explicitly include damage/scratch, broken-glass, detachable door/hood/boot/bumper and related component variants; do not flatten these into a single static body during conversion.
